signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> {L₁ : Type v} -> {L₂ : Type w} -> {L₃ : Type w₁} -> [CommRing R] -> [LieRing L₁] -> [LieAlgebra R L₁] -> [LieRing L₂] -> [LieAlgebra R L₂] -> [LieRing L₃] -> [LieAlgebra R L₃] -> (f : L₂ →ₗ⁅R⁆ L₃) -> (g : L₁ →ₗ⁅R⁆ L₂) -> L₁ →ₗ⁅R⁆ L₃

conventions.statement: The first argument `f` is the outer (post-) morphism and the second argument `g` is the inner (pre-) morphism, so `VTask.comp f g` applied to `x` yields `f (g x)`, following standard mathematical left-to-right composition notation.
conventions.note: Mirrors the convention of LinearMap.comp and standard categorical composition.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {L₁ : Type*} {L₂ : Type*} {L₃ : Type*} [CommRing R] [LieRing L₁] [LieAlgebra R L₁] [LieRing L₂] [LieAlgebra R L₂] [LieRing L₃] [LieAlgebra R L₃] (f : L₂ →ₗ⁅R⁆ L₃) (g : L₁ →ₗ⁅R⁆ L₂) (x y : L₁), VTask.comp f g ⁅x, y⁆ = ⁅VTask.comp f g x, VTask.comp f g y⁆
